name: app-sidebar
origin: shadcn/ui block sidebar-07 (via EMITTE), rebuilt on the registry's react-aria Sidebar, Collapsible and DropdownMenu
description: An app-shell sidebar block, collapsible to icons: a team switcher (or a static logo), one navigation section per `data.nav` entry and a user menu. Driven by an `AppSidebarData` object, so teams, sections and items are data. Items with sub-items expand inline (`variant: "collapse"`) or open a menu (`"dropdown"`, and always while collapsed to icons). Links are react-aria `Link`s: wrap the app in `RouterProvider` for client-side routing. `onTeamChange`, `onAddTeam` and `onUserAction` handle the menus. Render inside a `SidebarProvider`.
